blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Supreme Court on Wednesday said that any criminal or administrative liability in the illegal increase and transfer of funds by lawmakers in the 2024 and 2025 national budget should be filed in the appropriate tribunals. Camille Ting, the high tribunal’s spokesperson, said that proper cases should be filed against certain government officials to exact accountability in the substantial increase in the proposed budget in the last two years that was declared unconstitutional. The government also may also challenge the Supreme Court decision by way of a motion for reconsideration as it is not yet final and executory. […]...
